note: Curated MCP connectors for sales work. Data only — nothing here is
enabled, credentialed, or executed by shipping this file. The Connectors
screen renders these entries and the user turns one on after supplying
Inclusion rule: first-party only. Every entry is published and hosted by
the vendor that owns the data it reaches. Community CRM connectors were
reviewed and excluded — the common pattern is `npx <pkg>` resolving the
latest version at launch, which means unreviewed third-party code running
locally with a CRM token that can read every customer record. That is not
a trade this product makes on the user's behalf. Users who want one can
still add it by hand in config.yaml; we just don't ship it as a default.
`url` is null where the endpoint is tenant-specific and the user must
copy it from their own admin console. We do not guess these.

servers.label: Salesforce
servers.urlSource: Salesforce Setup → MCP Servers. The endpoint is per-org.
servers.dataAccess: CRM records, flows, Apex actions and queries the signed-in user can already reach
servers.whySafe: The agent inherits the user's own permissions — CRUD, field-level security and sharing rules still apply, and the human's name stays on the audit trail.

servers.label: HubSpot
servers.urlSource: HubSpot developer console → MCP. Scoped to your portal.
servers.dataAccess: Contacts, companies, deals and engagements in the connected portal
servers.whySafe: Published by HubSpot against their own API, so scopes are the ones the portal already enforces.
servers.requires: Latest Developer Platform version on the portal

servers.label: Google Calendar
servers.urlSource: Google Cloud console → managed MCP servers.
servers.dataAccess: Calendar events for the signed-in account
servers.whySafe: Google-managed server; consent and scope review happen in the Google account flow rather than in this app.

servers.label: Gmail
servers.urlSource: Google Cloud console → managed MCP servers.
servers.dataAccess: Mail threads for the signed-in account
servers.whySafe: Google-managed server; scopes are granted and revocable in the user's Google account.
servers.caution: 메일 본문은 이 앱의 정형 PII 비식별화를 거치지만 이름·자유 서술은 마스킹되지 않는다. 고객 데이터 규칙은 sales/customer-data-handling 스킬을 따를 것.
